en.summary: Fixes one-warp operand-collector arbitration so one input class cannot starve the other under sustained contention.
why_it_counts: The patch changes core issue-pipeline arbitration.
The commit message explicitly says num_warp=1 had a bug.
The new logic directly changes forward progress in hardware.
disqualifiers: The commit also touches build and test files.
The bug is specific to the single-warp configuration.
evidence: instDemux now has a dedicated num_warp == 1 branch.
A new priorityXorV register alternates first priority between the two inputs.
The old fixed-priority path remains only for num_warp > 1.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: Two producer classes share the same collector outputs in the one-context configuration. If arbitration is fixed-priority instead of fair, one class can monopolize the first free slot and block the other indefinitely.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Both input classes stay valid while only one or a few collector destinations are free each cycle.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Replace alternating or round-robin first choice with fixed priority for one input class.
portability_notes: Map this to any two-stream arbiter feeding shared collector or issue entries.
The reusable bug is lost fairness in a single-context special case.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the one-context arbiter that assigns collector destinations to two competing inputs.
Delete the state bit that alternates first priority.
Always let the same input claim the first ready destination.

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix adds a toggling priority bit so V and X inputs alternate first choice only in the one-warp path.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Remove the num_warp == 1 alternating-priority branch and reuse the old fixed-priority outReady1/outReady2 selection.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: One operand stream can starve the other, causing stalls, timeouts, or hang-like loss of forward progress in one-warp builds.
evidence_for_injection: priorityXorV is introduced only for the one-warp path.
The code comment says alternation is needed to avoid blocking instructions.
The generic non-alternating path is the pre-fix behavior.
notes: Only the arbitration logic is needed for reinjection.
The build and test edits are not part of the fault.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了单 warp 配置下的 operand collector 仲裁问题，避免某一路输入在持续竞争时长期饿死另一路。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改了核心 issue 流水线中的仲裁逻辑。
提交信息明确说明 num_warp=1 存在 bug。
新增逻辑会直接改变硬件前进性。
disqualifiers: 该提交还修改了构建和测试文件。
该问题只出现在单 warp 配置下。
evidence: instDemux 新增了专门的 num_warp == 1 分支。
新增的 priorityXorV 寄存器会在两个输入之间交替首选优先级。
旧的固定优先级路径只保留给 num_warp > 1。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 在单上下文配置下，两类 producer 共享同一组 collector 输出。如果仲裁改成固定优先级而不是公平轮转，其中一路就可能长期占据首个可用槽位并阻塞另一路。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 单上下文 collector 仲裁
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 两路输入持续同时有效，而每个周期只有一个或少量 collector 目的槽可用。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 把交替或轮转首选改回固定优先级，让同一路输入总是先选。
portability_notes: 可映射到任何把两路输入送入共享 collector 或 issue entry 的仲裁器。
可复用缺陷的本质是单上下文特例下失去公平性。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到 one-context 模式下为两路竞争输入分配 collector 目的槽的仲裁器。
删除负责交替首选优先级的状态位。
始终让同一路输入拿走第一个 ready 目的槽。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: num_warp == 1 时的 instDemux 仲裁逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复在单 warp 路径中加入了可翻转的优先级位，让 V 和 X 两路输入轮流获得首选机会。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 删除 num_warp == 1 的交替优先级分支，恢复旧的固定优先级 outReady1/outReady2 选择。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 在单 warp 构建下，其中一路输入可能长期饿死另一路，造成停顿、超时或类似挂起的前进性丢失。
evidence_for_injection: priorityXorV 只为单 warp 路径而新增。
代码注释明确说明交替优先级是为了避免指令被阻塞。
通用非交替路径就是修复前行为。
notes: 回注时只需要仲裁逻辑。
构建和测试改动不属于故障本体。
